잠언-17-1.title: 잠언 17장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-1.exegesis: 33. Seemingly the most fortuitous events are ordered by God.
잠언-17-1.theologicalNote: 33. Seemingly the most fortuitous events are ordered by God.

잠언-17-2.title: 잠언 17장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 17 Pr 17:1-28 . 1. sacrifices-- or, "feasts" made with part of them (compare Pr 7:14 ; Le 2:3 ; 7:31). with-- literally, "of." strife-- its product, or attendant.
잠언-17-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 17 Pr 17:1-28 . 1. sacrifices-- or, "feasts" made with part of them (compare Pr 7:14 ; Le 2:3 ; 7:31). with-- literally, "of." strife-- its product, or attendant.

잠언-17-3.title: 잠언 17장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-3.exegesis: 2. (Compare Pr 14:35 ). causeth shame-- ( Pr 10:5 ). shall ... inheritance-- that is, share a brother's part (compare Nu 27:4 , 7 ).
잠언-17-3.theologicalNote: 2. (Compare Pr 14:35 ). causeth shame-- ( Pr 10:5 ). shall ... inheritance-- that is, share a brother's part (compare Nu 27:4 , 7 ).

잠언-17-4.title: 잠언 17장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-4.exegesis: 3. God only knows, as He tries ( Psa 12:6 ; 66:10 ) the heart.
잠언-17-4.theologicalNote: 3. God only knows, as He tries ( Psa 12:6 ; 66:10 ) the heart.

잠언-17-5.title: 잠언 17장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-5.exegesis: 4. Wicked doers and speakers alike delight in calumny.
잠언-17-5.theologicalNote: 4. Wicked doers and speakers alike delight in calumny.

잠언-17-6.title: 잠언 17장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-6.exegesis: 5. (Compare Pr 14:31 ). glad at calamities-- rejoicing in others' evil. Such are rightly punished by God, who knows their hearts.
잠언-17-6.theologicalNote: 5. (Compare Pr 14:31 ). glad at calamities-- rejoicing in others' evil. Such are rightly punished by God, who knows their hearts.

잠언-17-7.title: 잠언 17장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-7.exegesis: 6. Prolonged posterity is a blessing, its cutting off a curse ( Pr 13:22 ; Psa 109:13-15 ), hence children may glory in virtuous ancestry.
잠언-17-7.theologicalNote: 6. Prolonged posterity is a blessing, its cutting off a curse ( Pr 13:22 ; Psa 109:13-15 ), hence children may glory in virtuous ancestry.

잠언-17-8.title: 잠언 17장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-8.exegesis: 7. Excellent speech-- (Compare Margin). Such language as ill suits a fool, as lying (ought to suit) a prince ( Pr 16:12 , 13 ).
잠언-17-8.theologicalNote: 7. Excellent speech-- (Compare Margin). Such language as ill suits a fool, as lying (ought to suit) a prince ( Pr 16:12 , 13 ).

잠언-17-9.title: 잠언 17장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-9.exegesis: 8. One so corrupt as to take a bribe evinces his high estimate of it by subjection to its influence ( Pr 18:16 ; 19:6 ).
잠언-17-9.theologicalNote: 8. One so corrupt as to take a bribe evinces his high estimate of it by subjection to its influence ( Pr 18:16 ; 19:6 ).

잠언-17-10.title: 잠언 17장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-10.exegesis: 9. seeketh love-- (Compare Margin). The contrast is between the peace-maker and tale-bearer.
잠언-17-10.theologicalNote: 9. seeketh love-- (Compare Margin). The contrast is between the peace-maker and tale-bearer.

잠언-17-11.title: 잠언 17장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-11.exegesis: 10. Reproof more affects the wise than severe scourging, fools.
잠언-17-11.theologicalNote: 10. Reproof more affects the wise than severe scourging, fools.

잠언-17-12.title: 잠언 17장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-12.exegesis: 11. Such meet just retribution ( 1Ki 2:25 ). a cruel messenger-- one to inflict it.
잠언-17-12.theologicalNote: 11. Such meet just retribution ( 1Ki 2:25 ). a cruel messenger-- one to inflict it.

잠언-17-13.title: 잠언 17장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-13.exegesis: 12. They are less rational in anger than wild beasts.
잠언-17-13.theologicalNote: 12. They are less rational in anger than wild beasts.

잠언-17-14.title: 잠언 17장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-14.exegesis: 13. (Compare Psa 7:4 ; 35:12 ). evil-- injury to another ( Pr 13:21 ).
잠언-17-14.theologicalNote: 13. (Compare Psa 7:4 ; 35:12 ). evil-- injury to another ( Pr 13:21 ).

잠언-17-15.title: 잠언 17장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-15.exegesis: 14. letteth ... water-- as a breach in a dam. before ... meddled with-- before strife has become sharp, or, by an explanation better suiting the figure, before it rolls on, or increases.
잠언-17-15.theologicalNote: 14. letteth ... water-- as a breach in a dam. before ... meddled with-- before strife has become sharp, or, by an explanation better suiting the figure, before it rolls on, or increases.

잠언-17-16.title: 잠언 17장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-16.exegesis: 15. abomination ... Lord-- as reversing His method of acting ( Pr 3:32 ; 12:2 ).
잠언-17-16.theologicalNote: 15. abomination ... Lord-- as reversing His method of acting ( Pr 3:32 ; 12:2 ).

잠언-17-17.title: 잠언 17장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-17.exegesis: 16. Though wealth cannot buy wisdom for those who do not love it, yet wisdom procures wealth ( Pr 3:16 ; 14:24 ).
잠언-17-17.theologicalNote: 16. Though wealth cannot buy wisdom for those who do not love it, yet wisdom procures wealth ( Pr 3:16 ; 14:24 ).

잠언-17-18.title: 잠언 17장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-18.exegesis: 17. To the second of these parallel clauses, there is an accession of meaning, that is, that a brother's love is specially seen in adversity.
잠언-17-18.theologicalNote: 17. To the second of these parallel clauses, there is an accession of meaning, that is, that a brother's love is specially seen in adversity.

잠언-17-19.title: 잠언 17장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-19.exegesis: 18. (Compare Pr 6:1-5; 11 :15). in the presence, &c.-- that is, he either fails to consult his friend, or to follow his advice.
잠언-17-19.theologicalNote: 18. (Compare Pr 6:1-5; 11 :15). in the presence, &c.-- that is, he either fails to consult his friend, or to follow his advice.

잠언-17-20.title: 잠언 17장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-20.exegesis: 19. strife-- contention is, and leads to, sin. he that exalteth his gate-- gratifies a vain love of costly building. seeketh-- or, "findeth," as if he sought (compare "loveth death," Pr 8:36 ).
잠언-17-20.theologicalNote: 19. strife-- contention is, and leads to, sin. he that exalteth his gate-- gratifies a vain love of costly building. seeketh-- or, "findeth," as if he sought (compare "loveth death," Pr 8:36 ).

잠언-17-21.title: 잠언 17장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-21.exegesis: 20. The second clause advances on the first. The ill-natured fail of good, and the cavilling and fault-finding incur evil.
잠언-17-21.theologicalNote: 20. The second clause advances on the first. The ill-natured fail of good, and the cavilling and fault-finding incur evil.

잠언-17-22.title: 잠언 17장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-22.exegesis: 21. (Compare Pr 23:24 ). Different words are rendered by "fool," both denoting stupidity and impiety.
잠언-17-22.theologicalNote: 21. (Compare Pr 23:24 ). Different words are rendered by "fool," both denoting stupidity and impiety.

잠언-17-23.title: 잠언 17장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-23.exegesis: 22. (Compare Pr 14:30 ; 15:13 ). The effect of the mind on the body is well known. medicine-- or, "body," which better corresponds with "bone." drieth-- as if the marrow were exhausted.
잠언-17-23.theologicalNote: 22. (Compare Pr 14:30 ; 15:13 ). The effect of the mind on the body is well known. medicine-- or, "body," which better corresponds with "bone." drieth-- as if the marrow were exhausted.

잠언-17-24.title: 잠언 17장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-24.exegesis: 23. a gift ... bosom-- Money and other valuables were borne in a fold of the garment, called the bosom. to pervert-- that is, by bribery.
잠언-17-24.theologicalNote: 23. a gift ... bosom-- Money and other valuables were borne in a fold of the garment, called the bosom. to pervert-- that is, by bribery.

잠언-17-25.title: 잠언 17장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-25.exegesis: 24. Wisdom ... him-- ever an object of regard, while a fool's affections are unsettled.
잠언-17-25.theologicalNote: 24. Wisdom ... him-- ever an object of regard, while a fool's affections are unsettled.

잠언-17-26.title: 잠언 17장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-26.exegesis: 25. a grief-- or cross, vexation (compare Pr 17:21 ; 10:1 ).
잠언-17-26.theologicalNote: 25. a grief-- or cross, vexation (compare Pr 17:21 ; 10:1 ).

잠언-17-27.title: 잠언 17장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-27.exegesis: 26. Also-- that is, Equally to be avoided are other sins: punishing good subjects, or resisting good rulers.
잠언-17-27.theologicalNote: 26. Also-- that is, Equally to be avoided are other sins: punishing good subjects, or resisting good rulers.

잠언-17-28.title: 잠언 17장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-17-28.exegesis: 27-28. Prudence of speech is commended as is an excellent or calm spirit, not excited to vain conversation.
잠언-17-28.theologicalNote: 27-28. Prudence of speech is commended as is an excellent or calm spirit, not excited to vain conversation.
